shots.visual: A fierce emperor slams his fist on the throne table in rage, eyes wide with anger under dim palace lighting.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 司馬懿，你竟然敢背叛朕！

shots.visual: Emperor aggressively throws a secret letter onto the stone floor.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 看他寫給劉備的投誠信！

shots.visual: A calm general sitting at a wooden desk in a war tent, expertly forging handwriting with a calligraphy brush.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 曹丕本就多疑性狠。

shots.visual: An advisor standing on the left holding a feather fan, looking stunned at the general sitting on the right.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公這是要施反間計？

shots.visual: Hands stamping an official seal onto the secret forged letter with dark red ink.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 借曹丕之手，除朕大敵。

shots.visual: The general stands in the tent illuminated by torch light, handing the forged scroll to a soldier.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 把這信『偶然』留給魏軍。

shots.visual: A shadowy soldier figure running away through a dark, misty battlefield at midnight.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 魏軍俘虜將密信帶回洛陽。

shots.visual: Emperor glaring down menacingly from the high throne.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 密信當真來自司馬府？

shots.visual: Clenched fist holding the opened scroll, trembling violently with deep mistrust.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 連私人印信都蓋上了！

shots.visual: A young warlord standing on a warship deck, holding a scout report with a sly smirk.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 曹魏若內亂，東吳便可獲利。

shots.visual: A fierce female warrior in armor on the left speaking sternly to the lord standing on the right.

lines.speaker: sun_shangxiang
lines.text: 兄長小心，劉備絕非等閒！

shots.visual: The lord waves his hand dismissively, gazing out at the misty river with arrogance.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 劉備不過是運氣好罷了。

shots.visual: Emperor's eyes flash with murderous cruelty in the dark grand court.

lines.speaker: cao_pi
lines.text: 拿朕令箭，即刻逮捕司馬懿！

shots.visual: Heavily armored guards march aggressively out of palace gates under gloomy skies.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 魏國洛陽，頓時風聲鶴唳。

shots.visual: An advisor holding a feather fan stands over a map table, shaking his head in shock.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 不費一兵一卒，竟然瓦解魏軍。

shots.visual: A stern general standing in profile, lit by firelight, eyes cold and calculating.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 魏國失其智囊，指日可破。

shots.visual: Advisor on the left staring at the general's rigid back on the right with deep worry.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公這般心計，實令人膽寒。

shots.visual: General turns around half-face to camera, expression devoid of any hesitation or mercy.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 對敵人仁慈，就是對自己殘忍。

shots.visual: Heavy iron dungeon gates slam shut with sparks flying in the dark prison hallway.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 司馬懿遭疑押入死牢。

shots.visual: A hand firmly places a black chess piece on a wooden board, capturing the opponent's piece.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 第一顆棋子落下了。

shots.visual: Cold smirk on the warlord's face, dark cinematic lighting highlighting his ambition, frozen dramatic shot.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 接下來，輪到襄陽了。
